# Fixture: the benchmark comparison from PR #392 (the elps v1.48.1 -> v1.50.0
# bump), reduced to the rows the verdict turns on and to two neighbours that
# must NOT be waived.  Deltas, p-values and n are the ones the workflow's own
# PR comment reported.
#
# Three rows sit at or above the 10% gate, and all three are covered by
# scripts/benchstat-waivers.txt:
#
#     shirocore  Utils/$load-4                B/op       +17.82% (ceiling 20)
#     shirocore  Utils/$load-4                allocs/op  +11.50% (ceiling 14)
#     preheat    PhylumPreheater_initPhylum-4 B/op       +12.85% (ceiling 15)
#
# The sec/op rows moved the other way -- the elps aliasing fixes made loading
# FASTER -- and preheat's allocs/op moved by less than the gate, so neither is
# waived and both stay gated at full strength.  With BENCH_WAIVERS= (waivers
# off) this table must fail; with the shipped waivers it must pass, with all
# three rows reported as WAIVED.
